data.name: Cli_Usage
data.value:
easyservice - manage Windows services through a GUI (alternative to nssm.exe)
Without arguments the graphical interface starts.
MANAGE easyservice list [--json] Lists all services; the ones managed by EasyService are marked.
easyservice install <name> <program> [arguments...] Creates a new service (autostart, logging under %ProgramData%\EasyService\logs).
easyservice remove <name> Stops and removes the service.
easyservice start|stop|restart|status <name> Controls an existing service. status also understands --json.
MONITORING easyservice checkmk Checkmk local check: one line per monitored service, with perfdata.
easyservice prometheus [--output <file>] Prometheus exposition format. Use --output for the textfile collector of node_exporter (the file is replaced atomically).
easyservice check <name> Nagios/Icinga plugin for one service. Exit code 0 = OK, 1 = warning, 2 = critical, 3 = unknown.
easyservice json Complete state of all monitored services as JSON.
easyservice zabbix-discovery Low-level discovery list for Zabbix templates.
INTERFACE easyservice gui [name] Starts the interface, optionally at the given service.
easyservice gui --new Starts the interface and opens the quick setup right away.
easyservice gui --history <name> Starts the interface and opens that service's history right away.
Managing requires administrator rights; the monitoring commands only read.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Account
data.value: Format: DOMAIN\User, or .\User for local accounts. EasyService grants the account the "Log on as a service" right automatically.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Arguments
data.value: Arguments are passed to the program unchanged. Please quote paths that contain spaces.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Cpu100
data.value: 100 % means every core of the machine is fully busy.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Dependencies
data.value: Services that have to run before this one - one name per line. Windows only starts the service once all of them are running.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Environment
data.value: Additional environment variables for the application - one per line in the form NAME=VALUE. Existing variables such as %PATH% can be used.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Exit
data.value: What should happen when the application exits by itself?

data.name: Editor_Hint_ExitCodes
data.value: Example: set exit code 0 to "Stop the service" so a program that finished cleanly is not restarted forever.

data.name: Editor_Hint_HistoryDays
data.value: 0 = record no history. One row per minute, about 80 KB per service and day, stored as CSV under %ProgramData%\EasyService\history.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Interact
data.value: Only possible with the local system account. Modern Windows versions isolate services in session 0; windows of the application are not visible to logged-on users.

data.name: Editor_Hint_KeepPassword
data.value: Leave empty to keep the stored password.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Logging
data.value: Everything the application writes to stdout and stderr ends up in these files. If both point at the same file, the streams are merged.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Memory
data.value: The whole process tree is measured, not just the main process.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Monitoring
data.value: Windows reports a service as "running" as long as EasyService itself is alive - even when the application behind it crashes every minute. EasyService therefore also judges restart frequency, CPU and memory and passes the verdict on to your monitoring.

data.name: Editor_Hint_NoTerminate
data.value: Without a hard terminate a hung process can block Windows from shutting down.

data.name: Editor_Hint_ReplaceEnvironment
data.value: Careful: when replacing, the application only receives the variables listed above. Without PATH and SystemRoot many programs will not start.

data.name: Editor_Hint_ServiceName
data.value: Internal name Windows uses for the service. Cannot be changed after creation.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Shutdown
data.value: When the service stops, EasyService tries to close the application gracefully in stages. Every enabled stage waits the given time before the next one follows.

data.name: Editor_Hint_StartupDelay
data.value: Time to wait before the application is launched for the first time after the service starts.

data.name: Editor_Hint_Throttle
data.value: If the application exits faster than the throttle window, EasyService doubles the wait before each further attempt (up to 60 s). That prevents restart loops caused by a permanently broken configuration.

data.name: Editor_Hint_ZeroOff
data.value: 0 means: do not check this value.
